items.label: 【Country-Inspired Elegance with Generous Length】
items.value: The console table showcases a charm endemic to farmhouse-style decor. Its impressive length of 63 inches lends abundant space for the display of decorative pieces, creating a welcoming ambiance in any home

items.label: 【Sturdy Craftsmanship and Material 】
items.value: Built using engineered wood MDF, the elegant hallway table is designed to withstand daily wear and tear. Its appealing wood-like finish contributes to an authentic aesthetic, enhancing its rustic appeal and solid construction

items.label: 【Improved Stability with Foot Pads】
items.value: Stability and safety take front row with the inclusion of foot pads that prevent the sofa table from wobbling and maintain its firm placement on the floor. These functional yet subtle components preserve the table's sleek design

items.label: 【Utilitarian Design for Multiple Home Areas】
items.value: The rustic entryway table unassuming yet elegant look lends it versatility. Whether used as a stylish surface in the entryway, a functional piece behind the sofa in the living room, or a decorative accent console in a hallway area, the hallway table proves its adaptability across different home settings

items.label: 【Simple Assembly and Quality Assurance】
items.value: Our detailed instructions, labeled parts, and included hardware make assembly a cinch. Note: We provide two installation videos. Please match the SKU number on the packaging with the applicable SKU at the start of the video. Find the video that matches your product model to ensure the correct and smooth installation process.

items.label: NOTE
items.value: Due to variances in lighting and screen settings, the actual color of the console table may differ slightly from the color shown in the picture. There may be many screws, but they are there to ensure that the table is sturdy enough and to hide the screws as much as possible at the back and inside. This can provide all customers with the best display effect and safety.
